pretreatments.description: Chemical pretreatment using sodium hydroxide (NaOH), sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO_3), sodium chloride (NaCl), citric acid (H_3Cit), acetic acid (AcOH), hydrogen peroxide (H_2O_2), acetone (Me_2CO) and ethanol (EtOH) at varying reagent dosages, process durations and temperatures.
Mechanical pretreatment involving food processor comminution and universal cutting mill comminution to reduce particle size less than 500 μm for cotton gin waste (CGW).
